section_summary.extract_value: This section reviews research on learning strategies, particularly for acquiring skills in complex, dynamic tasks. It introduces two main practice strategies: the identical elements strategy (practicing high-complexity scenarios) and a part-whole or task variability strategy (ramping up complexity). The section hypothesizes positive links between these strategies and learning outcomes such as knowledge, final training performance, and self-efficacy, and states that individual differences in goal orientation will be discussed in the next section.
